# Xodus Nexus 0.3.0

- Browse owned and Game Pass PC games together in My Library, with access and installation filters, title search and clear ownership labels.
- Show your Xbox gamertag, profile picture and detected Game Pass tier using the existing sign-in.
- Pause and resume downloads, including after restarting the launcher, with progress reported directly by the backend.
- Create desktop and application-menu shortcuts with each game's icon.
- Fix importing games whose executable paths use different letter casing.
- Show full game and edition names on hover and improve library pagination.
- Refresh the README demo and screenshots.

Update the Nexus backend in Settings to enable the new account library and download features.

Thanks to @Fail-2K, @lieserlV and @oGH0ULo for reports, feedback and feature suggestions.
